quote: Durch die Auswertung der „Panama Papers“ sind bis Februar 2021 bundesweit mehr als 38,4 Millionen Euro an zusätzlichen Steuereinnahmen erzielt worden.
translation: By February 2021, analysis of the Panama Papers had yielded more than 38.4 million euros in additional tax revenue nationwide.

este último financiado por entidades como a Ford Foundation, o Fundo da Família Rockefeller, a W. K. Kellogg Foundation ou o milionário George Soros
translation: the latter funded by entities such as the Ford Foundation, the Rockefeller Family Fund, the W. K. Kellogg Foundation or the millionaire George Soros

translation: Sergei Roldugin, a musician and close personal friend of Putin since childhood, could be the front for a clandestine network of the Russian president's business partners.

quote: In den Panama Papers finden sich die Namen zahlreicher Prominenter aus aller Welt, etwa die von 143 Politikern, darunter frühere und noch amtierende Staats- und Regierungschefs.
translation: The Panama Papers contain the names of numerous celebrities from around the world, including 143 politicians, among them former and serving heads of state and government.

quote: As primeiras notícias sobre o caso, assim como 149 dos próprios documentos, foram publicadas em 3 de abril de 2016.
translation: The first news about the case, along with 149 of the documents themselves, was published on 3 April 2016.

quote: Les premiers articles sont publiés le 3 avril 2016, accompagnés de 149 documents.
translation: The first articles are published on 3 April 2016, accompanied by 149 documents.

quote: After more than a year of analysis, the first news stories were published on April 3, 2016, along with 150 of the documents themselves.
abrange um intervalo de tempo entre a década de 1970 e o início de 2016
translation: covers a time span between the 1970s and the beginning of 2016

quote: remontent aux années 1970 et vont jusqu'à fin 2015
translation: go back to the 1970s and run to the end of 2015

quote: These documents, some dating back to the 1970s
報方將文件與國際調查記者同盟分享，後者動用了全世界來自72個國家與地區的116個媒體組織，以一年的時間整理這些文件
translation: The paper shared the documents with the ICIJ, which mobilised 116 media organisations from 72 countries and territories to spend a year organising the files.

quote: The whistleblower reported that the murder of journalists Daphne Caruana Galizia in 2017 and Ján Kuciak in 2018 due to their investigations of the Panama Papers had deeply affected him
Верховный суд Пакистана отстранил пожизненно от политики Наваза Шарифа. В 2018 году по следам панамских документов Шариф был заочно приговорён к 10 годам тюрьмы и оштрафован на 10,6 млн долларов
translation: Pakistan's Supreme Court banned Nawaz Sharif from politics for life. In 2018, following the Panama Papers, Sharif was sentenced in absentia to 10 years in prison and fined 10.6 million dollars

quote: El Tribunal Supremo de Pakistán destituyó al primer ministro del país, Nawaz Sharif, en medio de un escándalo por lavado de dinero y corrupción
translation: Pakistan's Supreme Court removed the country's prime minister, Nawaz Sharif, amid a money-laundering and corruption scandal

quote: Согласно источнику утечки, изначально он предложил документы «нескольким крупным изданиям» и WikiLeaks, после ознакомления с архивом отказавшимся работать с ними.
translation: According to the source of the leak, he initially offered the documents to "several major outlets" and WikiLeaks, which after reviewing the archive declined to work with them.

quote: Bevor der anonyme Whistleblower unter dem Pseudonym John Doe die Süddeutsche Zeitung anschrieb, hatte er sich schon an mehrere Nachrichtenagenturen und WikiLeaks gewandt. Die Süddeutsche Zeitung war die erste Institution, die antwortete.
translation: Before the anonymous whistleblower using the pseudonym John Doe wrote to the Süddeutsche Zeitung, he had already approached several news agencies and WikiLeaks. The Süddeutsche Zeitung was the first institution to respond.

quote: l'International Consortium for Investigative Journalism (ICIJ), avec McClatchy et le Miami Herald, ont été récompensés par le Prix Pulitzer 2017, dans la catégorie « explanatory reporting »
translation: the ICIJ, with McClatchy and the Miami Herald, were awarded the 2017 Pulitzer Prize in the category "explanatory reporting"

quote: Im April 2017 erhielt der ICIJ den Pulitzer-Preis für Hintergrundberichterstattung.
translation: In April 2017 the ICIJ received the Pulitzer Prize for background reporting.

quote: تضم مستندات توثّق تحويلات بنكيّة سرية مع شركات وهمية بقيمة ملياري دولار.
translation: They include documents recording secret bank transfers with fictitious companies worth two billion dollars.

quote: 文件提及140名政治人物中，當中有12名在任與前任國家領導人
translation: Of the 140 politicians mentioned in the documents, 12 are current and former national leaders

quote: Nos documentos são mencionados  chefes de estado em exercício de cinco países, nomeadamente Argentina, Islândia, Arábia Saudita, Ucrânia e Emirados Árabes Unidos
translation: The documents mention serving heads of state of five countries, namely Argentina, Iceland, Saudi Arabia, Ukraine and the UAE

quote: Les chefs d’État ou de gouvernement de sept pays — l'Arabie saoudite, l'Argentine, les Émirats arabes unis, l'Islande, le Pakistan, le Royaume-Uni et l'Ukraine — sont directement incriminés par ces révélations
translation: The heads of state or government of seven countries — Saudi Arabia, Argentina, the UAE, Iceland, Pakistan, the United Kingdom and Ukraine — are directly implicated by these revelations

quote: Entre aquellos cuyas transacciones se han hecho públicas se encuentran 12 jefes y exjefes de Estado
translation: Among those whose transactions became public are 12 current and former heads of state

quote: Named in the leak were 12 extant or former world leaders; 128 other public officials and politicians
La procuradora general panameña Kenia Porcell anunció el 24 de enero de 2017 que apoya las investigaciones contra el bufete de abogados Mossack Fonseca
translation: Panama's attorney general Kenia Porcell announced on 24 January 2017 that she supports the investigations against the law firm Mossack Fonseca

quote: Le 28 juin 2024 les 28 prévenus ont été déclarés innocents par la justice car les preuves « ne respectaient pas la chaîne de traçabilité »
translation: On 28 June 2024 the 28 defendants were declared innocent by the courts because the evidence "did not respect the chain of traceability"

quote: Am 28. Juni 2024 wurden alle mittlerweile 28 Angeklagten freigesprochen, da sich die Vorwürfe angeblich nicht ausreichend und schlüssig erhärten ließen.
translation: On 28 June 2024 all of the eventually 28 defendants were acquitted, since the allegations could allegedly not be substantiated sufficiently and conclusively.

quote: fundada em 1977 por Jürgen Mossack, filho de um agente da CIA nascido na Alemanha, e por Ramón Fonseca, um romancista e advogado panamenho.
translation: founded in 1977 by Jürgen Mossack, son of a CIA agent born in Germany, and by Ramón Fonseca, a Panamanian novelist and lawyer.

quote: que habría denunciado que Estados Unidos realizó la investigación a través del Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project y la financió la Open Society Foundations y el empresario George Soros, así como la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional
translation: which would have denounced that the United States carried out the investigation through the OCCRP, financed by the Open Society Foundations and the businessman George Soros, as well as USAID

quote: Na opinião do antigo embaixador britânico Craig Murray, é possível que os media corporativos com o monopólio de acesso aos documentos originais possam ter filtrado a informação de modo a promover uma agenda governamental
translation: In the opinion of the former British ambassador Craig Murray, it is possible that the corporate media with monopoly access to the original documents may have filtered the information to promote a government agenda

quote: WikiLeaks a réagi à cette mise en cause en déclarant notamment que « l’attaque contre Poutine a été écrite par l’OCCRP, un organisme qui cible la Russie et les anciennes républiques soviétiques et qui est financé par l’USAID et George Soros »
translation: WikiLeaks reacted to this criticism by declaring notably that "the attack against Putin was written by the OCCRP, an organisation targeting Russia and the former Soviet republics which is financed by USAID and George Soros"

quote: По данным международной некоммерческой организации WikiLeaks, за утечками «панамских документов» стоит Джордж Сорос и Агентство США по международному развитию (USAID).
translation: According to the international non-profit WikiLeaks, George Soros and the US Agency for International Development (USAID) stand behind the Panama Papers leaks.

quote: 文件中提到多家離岸公司由俄羅斯大提琴家謝爾蓋·羅爾杜金（Sergei Roldugin）擁有。
section: 涉案人員及披露內容/俄羅斯
translation: The documents mention several offshore companies owned by the Russian cellist Sergei Roldugin.

quote: Sergueï Roldouguine, un autre proche de Vladimir Poutine, est relié à sept sociétés offshores créées au Panama
translation: Sergei Roldugin, another close associate of Vladimir Putin, is linked to seven offshore companies created in Panama.

quote: Die Panama Papers zeigen, dass enge Vertraute des russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin offenbar über zwei Milliarden Dollar durch Briefkastenfirmen geschleust
translation: The Panama Papers show that close confidants of the Russian president apparently channelled over two billion dollars through shell companies.

quote: Сергей Ролдугин до 2015 года владел офшорными компаниями, через которые за несколько лет работы было проведено сделок на 2 миллиарда долларов.
translation: Sergei Roldugin until 2015 owned offshore companies through which deals worth 2 billion dollars were conducted over several years.

quote: wurde von Jürgen Mossack sowie dem Autor und Anwalt Ramón Fonseca Mora gegründet und existierte von 1977 bis März 2018.
translation: was founded by Jürgen Mossack and the author and lawyer Ramón Fonseca Mora and existed from 1977 to March 2018.

quote: 後者動用了全世界來自72個國家與地區的116個媒體組織，以一年的時間整理這些文件，並於2016年4月3日公布初步結果。
translation: The latter mobilised 116 media organisations from 72 countries and regions around the world, taking a year to organise the files and publishing initial results on 3 April 2016.

quote: يُزعم أن مكتب موساك فونسيكا ساعد رؤساء دول وشخصيات بارزة أخرى في التهرب الضريبي بإنشاء ملاجئ ضريبية غير قانونية في الأغلب.
translation: It is alleged that the Mossack Fonseca office helped heads of state and other prominent people evade taxes by creating tax shelters that were illegal in most cases.

quote: O recurso a empresas offshore não é por si só ilegal nas jurisdições em que estão registradas. No entanto, durante a investigação os jornalistas verificaram que algumas das companhias de fachada mencionadas nos documentos podem ter sido usadas para fins ilegais, incluindo fraude, tráfico de droga e evasão fiscal.
translation: Using offshore companies is not in itself illegal in the jurisdictions where they are registered. During the investigation, however, journalists found that some of the shell companies mentioned in the documents may have been used for illegal purposes, including fraud, drug trafficking and tax evasion.

quote: ICIJ同時承認，設立離岸公司不代表當事人一定有透過離岸公司進行不法活動
translation: The ICIJ also acknowledged that setting up an offshore company does not mean the person necessarily used it for illegal activity.

quote: Si dans la législation de la plupart des pays, les sociétés offshore ne sont pas illégales en elles-mêmes, c'est leur usage comme sociétés écrans dans l'évasion fiscale ou le blanchiment d'argent qui l'est.
translation: If, in the law of most countries, offshore companies are not illegal in themselves, it is their use as screen companies in tax evasion or money laundering that is.

quote: Nach Einschätzung der beteiligten Medien belegen die Unterlagen legale Strategien der Steuervermeidung, aber auch Steuer- und Geldwäschedelikte, den Bruch von UN-Sanktionen sowie andere Straftaten durch Kunden von Mossack Fonseca.
translation: In the view of the media involved, the documents show legal tax-avoidance strategies, but also tax and money-laundering offences, breaches of UN sanctions, and other crimes by Mossack Fonseca clients.

quote: No toda empresa fantasma es ilegal. Puede utilizarse en forma perfectamente legal
translation: Not every shell company is illegal. It can be used in a perfectly legal way

quote: While offshore business entities are legal, reporters found that some of the Mossack Fonseca shell corporations were used for illegal purposes, including fraud, tax evasion, and evading international sanctions.
En 2026, soit dix ans après les révélations, la DGFiP a mis en recouvrement un total de 271 millions d'euros dans des procédures liées à 230 dossiers.
translation: In 2026, ten years after the revelations, the public-finance directorate had put into collection a total of 271 million euros in procedures linked to 230 files.

quote: Dazu kommen weitere Einnahmen von gut 19 Millionen Euro aus der strafrechtlichen Verfolgung der Fälle. Hinzu kommen Steuermehreinnahmen von 14,5 Millionen Euro aus an das Ausland abgegebenen Datensätzen – insgesamt also rund 72 Millionen Euro.
section: == Sachverhalte und Folgen in anderen Ländern ==
translation: Added to that are further receipts of a good 19 million euros from criminal prosecution of the cases. In addition there are 14.5 million euros in extra tax revenue from data sets passed abroad — so about 72 million euros in all.

quote: En julio de 2026, Swedbank acordó pagar una multa de 50 millones de dólares al Departamento de Servicios Financieros de Nueva York por ocultar deliberadamente información vinculada a la firma Mossack Fonseca y los Panama Papers
translation: In July 2026, Swedbank agreed to pay a 50 million dollar fine to the New York Department of Financial Services for deliberately hiding information linked to the firm Mossack Fonseca and the Panama Papers

quote: In April 2019, the ICIJ and European newspapers reported that the global tally of recovered sums from litigation, fines and back taxes exceeded $1.2 billion.

Крупнейший китайский интернет-поисковик Baidu на запрос «Panama Papers» выдаёт следующий результат: «Результаты поиска не соответствуют законам и нормативным актам. Попробуйте ввести другой запрос», что свидетельствует о цензурировании результатов международного расследования от жителей Китая.
translation: The largest Chinese internet search engine, Baidu, returns this result for the query “Panama Papers”: “The search results do not comply with laws and regulations. Try another query,” which indicates censorship of the international investigation’s results from residents of China.

quote: Le président Xi Jinping, lancé dans une campagne anti corruption visant à assainir les rangs du parti, décrète la censure des médias sur le sujet alors que son propre beau-frère et des proches de 7 autres membres du comité permanent du Bureau politique du Parti communiste chinois sont cités dans les révélations.
translation: President Xi Jinping, engaged in an anti-corruption campaign aimed at cleaning up the party’s ranks, orders media censorship of the subject even as his own brother-in-law and relatives of 7 other members of the Politburo Standing Committee are named in the revelations.

quote: En los motores de búsqueda chinos la palabra «Panamá» está bloqueada o censurada.
translation: On Chinese search engines the word “Panama” is blocked or censored.

quote: Il a déclaré subventionner, via l'USAID, l'OCCRP (Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting project), un des organismes faisant partie du Consortium of Investigative Journalists, qui a reçu les documents, mais d'après le porte-parole du gouvernement, cette subvention est accordée sans contrôle éditorial.
translation: He said that it subsidizes, via USAID, the OCCRP (Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project), one of the bodies in the Consortium of Investigative Journalists, which received the documents, but according to the government spokesman this subsidy is granted without editorial control.

quote: Esta afirmación se apoya en un mensaje de una cuenta de Twitter, atribuida a Wikileaks, que habría denunciado que Estados Unidos realizó la investigación a través del Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project y la financió la Open Society Foundations y el empresario George Soros, así como la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional
translation: This claim rests on a message from a Twitter account attributed to WikiLeaks, which allegedly denounced that the United States carried out the investigation through the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project and that it was funded by the Open Society Foundations and the businessman George Soros, as well as the United States Agency for International Development

quote: Die Verwicklung Mizzis, Schembris und Muscats in die Affäre waren zuerst von der Journalistin Daphne Caruana Galizia aufgedeckt worden. Ohne selbst Mitglied des internationalen Rechercheteams zu sein oder Zugang zu den geleakten Papieren zu haben, recherchierte sie innerhalb Maltas.
section: == Sachverhalte und Folgen in anderen Ländern ==
translation: The involvement of Mizzi, Schembri and Muscat in the affair was first uncovered by the journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Without herself being a member of the international research team or having access to the leaked papers, she researched inside Malta.

quote: Asesinato de Dapnhe Caruana Galizia
translation: Murder of Dapnhe Caruana Galizia

quote: 2017年7月28日，巴基斯坦終審法院裁定因巴拿馬文件被調查的謝里夫表現不誠實而不再符合擔任公職的資格。不久之後，總理辦公室宣佈他辭任總理。
translation: On 28 July 2017, Pakistan’s final court ruled that Sharif, investigated because of the Panama Papers, had been dishonest and no longer met the qualification for public office. Soon afterward the prime minister’s office announced that he was resigning.

quote: Верховный суд Пакистана отстранил пожизненно от политики Наваза Шарифа. В 2018 году по следам панамских документов Шариф был заочно приговорён к 10 годам тюрьмы и оштрафован на 10,6 млн долларов по обвинению в коррупции.
translation: Pakistan’s Supreme Court barred Nawaz Sharif from politics for life. In 2018, following the Panama documents, Sharif was sentenced in absentia to 10 years in prison and fined 10.6 million dollars on a corruption charge.

quote: Au Pakistan, le premier ministre Nawaz Sharif est destitué par un vote unanime des cinq membres de la Cour suprême le 28 juillet 2017, pour corruption à la suite des révélations des Panama Papers.
translation: In Pakistan, Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif was removed by a unanimous vote of the five members of the Supreme Court on 28 July 2017, for corruption following the Panama Papers revelations.

quote: Os documentos indicam que Roldugin, o melhor amigo de Putin, que em setembro de 2014 tinha afirmado que "não possuía milhões", adquiriu ativos no valor de 100 milhões de dólares
translation: The documents indicate that Roldugin, Putin’s best friend, who in September 2014 had said he “did not own millions,” acquired assets worth 100 million dollars

quote: В частности, Сергей Ролдугин до 2015 года владел офшорными компаниями, через которые за несколько лет работы было проведено сделок на 2 миллиарда долларов.
translation: In particular, Sergei Roldugin owned offshore companies until 2015 through which deals worth 2 billion dollars were carried out over several years.

quote: Die Panama Papers zeigen, dass enge Vertraute des russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin offenbar über zwei Milliarden Dollar durch Briefkastenfirmen geschleust und dabei Hunderte Millionen Dollar außer Landes geschafft haben.
section: == Sachverhalte und Folgen in anderen Ländern ==
translation: The Panama Papers show that close associates of Russian president Vladimir Putin apparently channeled more than two billion dollars through shell companies and moved hundreds of millions of dollars out of the country.

quote: los documentos muestran que se han hecho transacciones por al menos 2000 millones de dólares mediante compañías offshore.
translation: the documents show that transactions of at least 2,000 million dollars were made through offshore companies.

quote: Премьер-министр Великобритании Дэвид Кэмерон признал, что вместе с женой владел пакетом акций в принадлежавшем его отцу Иэну Кэмерону офшорном фонде, но продал его ещё до того, как стал главой правительства.
translation: British prime minister David Cameron admitted that, with his wife, he had owned a shareholding in an offshore fund belonging to his father Ian Cameron, but sold it before he became head of government.

quote: Il en aurait ensuite écoulé l'actif en 2010 pour environ 30 000 livres, quelques mois avant d'être élu Premier ministre.
translation: He would then have sold the holding in 2010 for about 30,000 pounds, a few months before being elected prime minister.

quote: David Cameron besaß nach eigenen Angaben zusammen mit seiner Ehefrau Anteile im Wert von 30.000 Pfund (ca. 37.000 Euro) an diesem Trust.
section: == Sachverhalte und Folgen in anderen Ländern ==
translation: David Cameron said that, together with his wife, he owned shares in this trust worth 30,000 pounds (about 37,000 euros).

quote: El primer ministro del Reino Unido reconoció que él y su mujer poseyeron entre 1997 y 2010 un total de 5000 títulos del fondo Blairmore, dirigido por el padre de Cameron
translation: The prime minister of the United Kingdom acknowledged that he and his wife held, between 1997 and 2010, a total of 5,000 units of the Blairmore fund, run by Cameron’s father

quote: Mossack Fonseca fue una firma de abogados panameña fundada en 1977 por Jürgen Mossack y Ramón Fonseca Mora
translation: Mossack Fonseca was a Panamanian law firm founded in 1977 by Jürgen Mossack and Ramón Fonseca Mora

quote: Le 28 juin 2024 les 28 prévenus ont été déclarés innocents par la justice car les preuves « ne respectaient pas la chaîne de traçabilité » et ne permettaient pas d’établir avec « certitude leur authenticité et leur intégrité ».
translation: On 28 June 2024 the 28 defendants were declared innocent by the court because the evidence “did not respect the chain of traceability” and did not make it possible to establish “with certainty their authenticity and integrity.”

quote: Svo fór að lokum að Sigmundur vék sem forsætisráðherra og Sigurður Ingi Jóhannsson tók við embættinu.
translation: In the end Sigmundur stepped aside as prime minister and Sigurður Ingi Jóhannsson took over the office.

quote: 後者動用了全世界來自72個國家與地區的116個媒體組織，以一年的時間整理這些文件
translation: The latter mobilized 116 media organizations from 72 countries and regions worldwide and spent a year sorting these documents.

quote: документы ICIJ были переданы 107 медиаорганизациям по всему миру.
translation: the ICIJ documents were passed to 107 media organizations around the world.

quote: ils ont créé une équipe de 370 journalistes issus de 109 rédactions basées dans 76 pays :
translation: they created a team of 370 journalists from 109 newsrooms based in 76 countries:

quote: An der Recherche zu den Panama Papers und ihrer Aufbereitung für die Öffentlichkeit waren 376 Journalisten aus 76 Ländern beteiligt.
translation: 376 journalists from 76 countries took part in researching the Panama Papers and preparing them for the public.

quote: Na opinião do antigo embaixador britânico Craig Murray, é possível que os media corporativos com o monopólio de acesso aos documentos originais possam ter filtrado a informação de modo a promover uma agenda governamental, nomeadamente o The Guardian, Süddeutsche Zeitung, BBC e o consórcio de investigação que faz parte do Center for Public Integrity, este último financiado por entidades como a Ford Foundation, o Fundo da Família Rockefeller, a W. K. Kellogg Foundation ou o milionário George Soros.
translation: In the opinion of former British ambassador Craig Murray, it is possible that corporate media with a monopoly on access to the original documents may have filtered the information in order to promote a governmental agenda, namely The Guardian, Süddeutsche Zeitung, BBC and the investigative consortium that is part of the Center for Public Integrity, the latter funded by entities such as the Ford Foundation, the Rockefeller Family Fund, the W. K. Kellogg Foundation or millionaire George Soros.

quote: По данным международной некоммерческой организации WikiLeaks, за утечками «панамских документов» стоит Джордж Сорос и Агентство США по международному развитию (USAID). При этом, по мнению этой организации, одной из целей публикации была информационная атака на президента России Владимира Путина (по другим данным, WikiLeaks отрицает идею, что публикация была заговором против России).
translation: According to the international non-profit organization WikiLeaks, George Soros and the US Agency for International Development (USAID) are behind the 'Panama Papers' leaks. Moreover, according to this organization, one of the goals of the publication was an information attack on Russian President Vladimir Putin (according to other sources, WikiLeaks denies the idea that the publication was a conspiracy against Russia).

quote: Esta afirmación se apoya en un mensaje de una cuenta de Twitter, atribuida a Wikileaks, que habría denunciado que Estados Unidos realizó la investigación a través del Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project y la financió la Open Society Foundations y el empresario George Soros, así como la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional y que está dirigida contra Rusia.
translation: This claim is supported by a message from a Twitter account, attributed to WikiLeaks, which allegedly denounced that the United States carried out the investigation through the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project and that it was financed by the Open Society Foundations and businessman George Soros, as well as the United States Agency for International Development, and that it is directed against Russia.

quote: Le procès s'ouvre le 8 avril 2024 au Panama. Il concerne entre autres les deux fondateurs du cabinet d'avocat Mossack et Fonseca. Le 28 juin 2024 les 28 prévenus ont été déclarés innocents par la justice car les preuves « ne respectaient pas la chaîne de traçabilité » et ne permettaient pas d’établir avec « certitude leur authenticité et leur intégrité ».
translation: The trial opens on April 8, 2024 in Panama. It concerns among others the two founders of the law firm Mossack and Fonseca. On June 28, 2024 the 28 defendants were declared innocent by the court because the evidence 'did not respect the chain of custody' and did not allow to establish with 'certainty their authenticity and integrity'.

quote: Am 28. Juni 2024 wurden alle mittlerweile 28 Angeklagten freigesprochen, da sich die Vorwürfe angeblich nicht ausreichend und schlüssig erhärten ließen. Das Strafverfahren gegen den im Mai verstorbenen Ramón Fonseca wurde eingestellt.
translation: On June 28, 2024, all 28 defendants were acquitted, as the allegations allegedly could not be sufficiently and conclusively substantiated. The criminal proceedings against Ramón Fonseca, who died in May, were discontinued.

quote: La Policía uruguaya detuvo en Montevideo a 11 personas que son presuntos miembros del Cártel de Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG), el cual tenía varias sociedades abiertas en Panamá por intermedio de un bufete de abogados uruguayo que supuestamente realizaba actividades ilícitas de blanqueo de capitales provenientes del narcotráfico
translation: Uruguayan police arrested 11 people in Montevideo who are alleged members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG), which had several companies opened in Panama through a Uruguayan law firm that allegedly carried out illicit money laundering activities from drug trafficking
